name: WF-3: Salesforce → UT Quote + SF Writeback

nodes.name: Salesforce Webhook
nodes.notes:
Configure this URL in Salesforce Flow as: https://n8n.botonomy.xyz/webhook/salesforce-ut-quote
Add X-Salesforce-Signature header using the HMAC of the payload with SF_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote
nodes.notes:
Forwards the Salesforce payload directly to the portal's integration endpoint.
The portal validates the payload, runs the quote calculation, and persists to DB.

nodes.name: SF Writeback: Update Opportunity

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ Pricing_Details__c: 'Quote #' + $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.quoteNumber + ' | $' + $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.grandTotal.toFixed(2) + ' | Portal ID: ' + $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.quoteId, Price_Per__c: $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.grandTotal, Lab_Status__c: 'In Process', Quote_Due_Date__c: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) }) }}

nodes.notes:
Requires Salesforce OAuth2 credential configured in n8n:
  Grant Type: Client Credentials
  Client ID: SF_CLIENT_ID (from External Client App)
  Client Secret: SF_CLIENT_SECRET
  Token URL: https://ndt.my.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token
  ⚠ Use ndt.my.salesforce.com — NOT login.salesforce.com
Writes to existing Opportunity fields (no custom fields needed):
  Invoice_No__c, Total__c, Lab_Status__c='In Process', Quote_Due_Date__c, Pricing_Details__c

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, quoteId: $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.quoteId, quoteNumber: $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.quoteNumber, grandTotal: $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.grandTotal }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: $('POST /api/ut/integrations/salesforce/quote').first().json.error || 'Quote generation failed' }) }}
